manifest:
id = "web-fetch"
version = "0.1.0-alpha.1"
program = "yuki-web-fetch"
grants = ["tool.call"]
env = ["YUKI_WEB_FETCH_HTTP_PROXY","YUKI_WEB_FETCH_HTTPS_PROXY","YUKI_WEB_FETCH_ALL_PROXY","YUKI_WEB_FETCH_NO_PROXY"]

[[tools]]
name = "web_fetch"
description = "Read the text and source of a public HTTP or HTTPS page."
parallel_read = false
cacheable = false
code_direct = true
schema = {type="object",properties={url={type="string"}},required=["url"],additionalProperties=false}
